clues: This coastal city sits in Taiwan, in the north-west part. It faces the Taiwan Strait to the west.
Strong winds blow in from the northeast each year. They come in autumn and winter, with the monsoon season.
Austronesian peoples first lived on this land long ago. Han Chinese settlers founded this city in 1711.
This city holds a size record in Taiwan. It has more people than any other city that is not a special city.
People gave this city a nickname for its blustery weather. The name points to the strong seasonal winds here.
